lessons.text: To process an AP invoice, identify the actual invoice email in /mail (typically /mail/m/1), download the PDF attachment, read it via the pdf text layer, and extract vendor, invoice number, invoice date, due date, and total INR incl GST. Before recording, check duplicates in ERP via GET /bills?vendor_id=<ERP vendor ID>&invoice_number=<invoice no>; if an existing bill is returned, do not create a new bill and instead report the existing bill ID/status to AP lead.

When a duplicate invoice is found, compose a report to priya.nair@kestrel.in using /mail/compose; fill To, Subject, and Message fields, click Send, and verify it appears in Sent folder. Include vendor, invoice number, amount, existing bill ID, and payment status.

Do not assume the invoice is new; the plan may assume no duplicate, but you must still run the duplicate check first before recording or scheduling. In a verified run, the duplicate already existed with status Paid, so recording and scheduling steps were correctly skipped.
ERP vendor search endpoint /vendors?q=<name> returns fields including vendor ID and email_domain; the sender domain must exactly match email_domain for processing to continue.
AP lead email is priya.nair@kestrel.in; confirmation or fraud/duplicate reports are sent via /mail/compose and can be verified in the Sent folder.
